purpose: Final closure evidence index; does not alter frozen protocol, execution or acceptance criteria

provenance.requirement: Pin paper/native/LaZagna tools, dependencies, integration patches and binary hashes
provenance.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

physical_audit.requirement: SB, CB-O, Hybrid-O: count grid capacities, pin exits, cross-layer resources, directions and full path delays
physical_audit.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

compatibility.requirement: Prove packed netlist / placement / RRG compatibility before any cross-tool paired claim
compatibility.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

dual_baseline.requirement: Matched 2D denominator and same-architecture 3D denominator, with exact resource matching or explicit residual differences
dual_baseline.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

placement_routing.requirement: Both placement flows crossed with baseline and our routing, fixed inputs within every route pair
placement_routing.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

hyperparameters.requirement: criticality, K, delay budget and guide weights; disjoint circuit/seed tuning and held-out evaluation
hyperparameters.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

ablations.requirement: Fixed parameters and equally budgeted per-variant tuning; keep failures in denominators
ablations.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

architecture_ranking.requirement: Rank by absolute final CPD/common 2D normalization; seed stability and costs; allow no reversal
architecture_ranking.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

external_baselines.requirement: Keep paper VTR8.1, modern LaZagna port and official native VTR9 distinct; no unsupported ratios
external_baselines.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

timing.requirement: Serial repeats including official A0 and modern LaZagna where comparable; include setup/partition costs
timing.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

validation.requirement: VPR FULL plus independent directed-edge/switch/tree/capacity audit; evidence/trace checks
validation.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

closure.requirement: Preserve historical hashes, register all attempts, archive analysis, sources and acceptance audit
closure.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

partition_balance_sensitivity.requirement: Execute registered literal versus relative-3-percent P1 sensitivity; independently audit balance and separate placement effects from routing effects
partition_balance_sensitivity.gate: Inspect contents and actual coverage; existence or a passed receipt alone does not prove this requirement.

interpretation_gates: Use legal routes only for QoR; preserve all registered failures and coverage.
Use the same complete paired circuit cohort for 3D and parenthesized 2D improvements; bind maximum figures to one identical sample.
Keep training selection separate from heldout conclusions; no retuning.
Rank absolute CPD or common-2D normalized CPD on common architecture/flow/seed cohort; no required reversal.
Keep B1 literature separate from controlled B2 and official A0 comparisons.
Inspect all terminal logs once at closure for allocation-exception signatures alongside primary timeout/exit classification.
Reconcile observed P1 threads with threads_per_vpr=1 constraint explicitly; disclosure alone cannot prove the contradicted invariant.
Serial execution is not an exclusive-host claim; review setup-work differences and actual thread scope.
Verify full frozen source and historical artifact integrity at closure; this index performs no such broad verification.

known_contradiction.observation: P1 placement observed 128 threads, including nonmain CPU work
known_contradiction.status: unresolved_for_acceptance; no silent pass or redefinition
